summary: Preserved candidate PR 2689's valid pre-Ampere gates and added the missing gate for standalone QKNorm, closing review PR 2733's simulated-sm_75 loader counterexample.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before evidence: simulated sm_75 standalone QKNorm returned true and invoked _jit_qknorm_module once.
17 tests passed: all three affected loaders reject simulated sm_75 before loading; sm_80, sm_90, sm_121, and ROCm boundary behavior remains enabled.
On AMD Instinct MI350X/gfx950, the HIP exemption remained enabled, the residual-gate JIT executed, and fp32 output matched an independent CPU-fp64 expression with max_abs=0.0.
Environment blocker: 560 cases failed in the unchanged AOT reference because the installed extension lacks torch.ops.sgl_kernel.rmsnorm; the changed JIT path was not reached.
No whitespace errors in the consolidated correction.

gpu_execution_evidence: AMD Instinct MI350X/gfx950 with torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 executed the residual-gate HIP JIT and matched the independent numerical reference exactly for the fp32 fixture.
remaining_limitations: No NVIDIA sm_75 GPU or pip CUDA 13 nvcc/glibc environment was available, so the exact rsqrt/rsqrtf compiler clash and compiler-level latency elimination were not directly measured.
No FLUX.2-klein-4B weights were available, so full denoise first-step latency and model semantics were not measured.
The prepared ROCm environment's installed AOT sgl_kernel extension lacks torch.ops.sgl_kernel.rmsnorm, blocking the existing full QKNorm numerical test independently of this Python dispatch change.
